note: Wild animals (docs/animal/PLAN.md §3). Calm natural postures only: no hunting, prey, blood, bared fangs, injury or captivity. Main view is the side, where leg order and joint direction read clearly (D-14).

forms.species: red deer stag with a pair of branched antlers
forms.desc: standing calmly on all four slender legs, front legs straight and parallel, hind legs set back with the hocks angled backward, neck raised, head level and alert, two branched antlers with matching points on each side, ears up
forms.keep: calm four-leg stand, straight parallel front legs, hind legs set back with backward hocks, raised neck, two branched antlers

forms.coat: orange-red coat with a white chest and black legs
forms.desc: sitting on its haunches with straight front legs together, hind legs folded at the sides, bushy tail wrapped forward around the front paws, pointed muzzle, large upright pointed ears, head level facing forward
forms.keep: upright sit, front legs together, hind legs folded at the sides, bushy tail wrapped around the front paws, upright pointed ears
checks: 一条蓬松尾巴绕到前爪

forms.coat: orange-red coat with a white tail tip

name.ja: キツネ・丸まって寝る

forms.desc: lying curled into a tight round ball asleep, back rounded, head tucked against the hind legs, bushy tail wrapped all the way around covering the nose and front paws, ears flattened
forms.keep: tight curled ball, rounded back, head tucked to the hind legs, bushy tail wrapped around covering the nose

forms.desc: standing calmly on all four legs, front legs straight under the deep chest, hind legs set back with the hocks angled backward, long straight back, head level, mouth closed, ears up, tail hanging low and straight
forms.keep: calm four-leg stand, straight front legs, hind legs set back with backward hocks, level head, mouth closed, tail hanging low

forms.desc: walking on all four legs mid-stride: the right front and left hind legs forward, the left front and right hind legs back, heavy shoulder hump, head held low and level, flat-footed hind paws with the heel touching the ground, mouth closed
forms.keep: four-leg walk mid-stride with diagonal legs paired, shoulder hump, low head, flat-footed hind paws, mouth closed
checks: 正好四条腿、对角腿同步

forms.desc: standing calmly upright on both flat hind feet to look around, body vertical, front legs hanging relaxed in front of the chest with the paws down, head raised and level, ears up, mouth closed; not threatening, no raised claws
forms.keep: calm upright stand on flat hind feet, vertical body, front paws hanging relaxed in front of the chest, raised level head, mouth closed
checks: 前爪自然下垂、不是攻击姿势

forms.coat: orange coat with black stripes and a white belly
forms.desc: lying in a calm sphinx position: belly on the ground, front legs stretched straight forward and parallel, hind legs folded under the hips, head raised level facing forward, mouth closed, tail lying along the ground in a curve
forms.keep: calm sphinx down, belly on the ground, straight parallel front legs, hind legs folded under the hips, raised head, mouth closed, tail curved on the ground

forms.species: adult male lion with a full mane
forms.tail: one long tail with a tuft at the tip
forms.coat: tawny coat with a darker mane
forms.desc: sitting upright on its haunches, front legs straight and close together, hind legs folded at the sides, chest out, head held high facing forward with the full mane around it, mouth closed, tail curled forward along the ground
forms.keep: upright sit, straight front legs together, hind legs folded at the sides, head high with full mane, mouth closed, tail curled forward

forms.tail: a thin tail with a tuft at the tip
forms.desc: standing calmly on four thick pillar-like legs, the knees of the front legs bending forward and the hind legs bending backward, large ears relaxed against the head, trunk hanging straight down with the tip curled slightly forward, two short tusks
forms.keep: calm four-leg stand on pillar legs, large relaxed ears, trunk hanging straight with the tip curled, two short tusks

forms.tail: a long thin tail with a dark tuft
forms.coat: pale coat with large brown patches
forms.desc: standing calmly on four long legs, front legs slightly longer than the hind legs so the back slopes down to the hips, very long neck raised at about 60 degrees, head level, two short ossicone horns, ears out to the sides
forms.keep: calm four-leg stand, back sloping down to the hips, very long raised neck, level head, two short ossicones

forms.desc: sitting upright on its bottom with the hind legs stretched forward and apart on the ground, back rounded and leaning slightly back, front paws resting on the belly, round head facing forward, round ears up
forms.keep: sitting on its bottom, hind legs stretched forward and apart, rounded back, front paws on the belly, round ears up
checks: 坐在屁股上、后腿向前伸开

forms.coat: russet coat with a white face and dark legs

name.ja: レッサーパンダ・立ち姿

forms.desc: standing calmly on all four short legs, back slightly arched, head level facing forward with the white face, rounded upright ears, long bushy tail held out behind and curving slightly down
forms.keep: calm four-leg stand on short legs, slightly arched back, level head, rounded upright ears, bushy tail out behind
